- configure features: =--without-x --without-sound --without-pop --without-mailutils --without-dbus --without-gsettings --without-selinux --without-xwidgets --without-native-compilation --with-gnutls --with-zlib --with-xml2=
- required runtime probe: =(fboundp 'gnutls-available-p)=
- native compilation: disabled explicitly with =--without-native-compilation=; probe requires =native-comp=nil= and =libgccjit-dev= is intentionally absent.
- Debian bookworm emacs Build-Depends cross-check: source package =emacs_1:28.2+1-15+deb12u4= declares build dependencies including =ca-certificates=, =git=, =libgnutls28-dev=, =libncurses5-dev=, =libxml2-dev=, =texinfo=, and =zlib1g-dev=; the dorg image retains the matching selected-feature set (=ca-certificates git libgnutls28-dev libncurses-dev libxml2-dev texinfo zlib1g-dev=) plus the base compile tools (=build-essential make gcc libc6-dev=), =pkg-config= for the explicit GnuTLS/zlib/xml2 probes, and transfer/unpack tools (=curl xz-utils tar gzip=). Debian dependencies for disabled features are intentionally omitted from this non-X, non-native build path: X/GTK/image/sound/dbus/gsettings/selinux/systemd/native-comp/mail/package-maintainer tooling such as =libgccjit-12-dev=, =libacl1-dev=, =libasound2-dev=, =libcairo-dev=, =libdbus-1-dev=, =libgtk-3-dev=, =imagemagick=, =quilt=, =sharutils=, and =bsd-mailx | mailx=. Source: =https://sources.debian.org/data/main/e/emacs/1:28.2+1-15+deb12u4/debian/control=.

* Local image build

The image requires both locked Emacs inputs.  A local build must derive them
from this lock and pass both build arguments; the Dockerfile intentionally has
no version or archive-hash default:

#+begin_src sh
emacs_version=$(sed -n 's/^- version: =\(.*\)=$/\1/p' .github/dorg-suite-job/image-lock.org | head -n1)
emacs_sha256=$(sed -n 's/^- sha256: =\([0-9a-f]*\)=$/\1/p' .github/dorg-suite-job/image-lock.org | head -n1)
docker build --build-arg EMACS_VERSION="$emacs_version" \\
  --build-arg EMACS_SHA256="$emacs_sha256" \\
  -f .github/dorg-suite-job/Dockerfile .
#+end_src

* Dolt

- version: =1.86.4=
- source: =https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/releases/download/v1.86.4/dolt-linux-amd64.tar.gz=
- sha256: =88bdca99086bbac7f2414af2756c962d20a8d9b6463861dc2cf35111f13b6dea=
- install target: =/usr/local/bin/dolt=
- build identity: =dolt version= after =metrics.disabled=true= and =versioncheck.disabled=true= are written and read back in the image-build =HOME=.
- runtime identity: the entrypoint writes and reads back both settings in its fresh job-private =HOME= before any Dolt invocation. Both values are retained in =manifest.txt=, and each version probe has its own raw output in =probe/=.
- network behavior: the two settings disable anonymous usage uploads and the version out-of-date lookup, respectively. The suite container's Docker network policy is tracked separately in the private issue tracker.

* Git

- version: =2.49.0=
- source: =https://www.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/git-2.49.0.tar.xz=
- sha256: =618190cf590b7e9f6c11f91f23b1d267cd98c3ab33b850416d8758f8b5a85628=
- checksum source: =https://www.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/sha256sums.asc=
- additional build packages: =libcurl4-gnutls-dev libexpat1-dev libssl-dev gettext=
- install prefix: =/usr/local=; =NO_TCLTK=YesPlease= omits the GUI tools.
- runtime probe: =git --version= must report =git version 2.49.0=; the
  observed version is retained in =probe/versions.txt= and =manifest.txt=.
- rationale: the maintenance fixture contract uses the tested 2.49 behavior.
  Bookworm's distribution Git remains available at =/usr/bin/git=, but
  =/usr/local/bin/git= is the job's pinned default. The preflight refuses a
  PATH that selects the distribution version.

* Source packet admission

The image includes Debian =python3= for the standard-library archive,
JSON and hash reader in =tools/dorg-suite-job-source.py=. It installs after the
pinned toolchain layers. No Python package registry or third-party module is
used. The image digest identifies the actual runtime package build.

The optional source packet is a tar of =manifest.json= and flat regular Git
bundles. Admission verifies every bundle hash and size, exact commit/tree,
and the complete recursive gitlink set before the ordinary make commands.
The archive is never extracted onto source paths. No submodule URL is fetched.

* Process and terminal tools

- packages: =tmux procps=, unpinned Debian bookworm apt packages, installed after Python.
- consumer: Meld remote suite.
- probes: =tmux -V=, =ps --version=, and =pgrep --version=; actual values are retained in the job evidence.
